summary: Frontend-only verification of JMA polish round: (a) JMA shield logo replaces Music icon on AudioUnlockOverlay AND PlayerNamePrompt, (b) playerStorage.js abstraction with canonical snapshot, (c) PrintReport now reads from getPlayerSnapshot() and exposes Backup button that downloads a JSON file. All 6 review scenarios verified PASS on https://jelly-notes-lab.preview.emergentagent.com (1280x900).
critical_code_review_comments: AudioUnlockOverlay still wraps a motion.h1, motion.p and motion.div inside a <motion.button> — invalid HTML (block descendants of a button). Carried over from previous iteration; consider role='button' on a motion.div with tabIndex=0 + keydown handler. Functionally fine.

PrintReport.js calls getPlayerSnapshot() on every render. The snapshot reads ~8 localStorage keys synchronously each pass — acceptable here (component renders only when modal is open) but if it ever gets memoized into a parent re-render path, wrap in useMemo keyed on `open`.

playerStorage.importPlayerSnapshot() writes legacy keys but does NOT broadcast a 'storage' event to live React hooks (useStickers/useRank/etc.) — currently fine since import is only intended for offline/dev tooling, but after backend ships you'll want a small event/observer so hooks rehydrate without a full page reload.

Snapshot 'bestScores.sightReading' falls back to {} via readJson default; existing code in /lib reads localStorage value '0'/'1' as boolean (lines 71-72). This is a subtle coupling: any legacy key that ever stores the literal string '0' or '1' will be interpreted as boolean, not number/string. Currently only `jma_teacher_view_v1` uses 0/1, so it works — but worth a code comment in readJson to flag that branch is teacher-view-specific.

Backup filename uses `snapshot.displayName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')` — does not strip diacritics or special chars. Edge case: a kid named 'Léa/Ana' would produce 'léa/ana.json' (slash invalid in filename). Consider .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g,'-').
seed_data_creation: Seeded jma_player_v1 (displayName=Ella Tester), jma_stickers_v1 (6 cadet earns across all 6 domains), jma_practice_streak_v1 (count=7), jma_total_play_ms_v1 (125000), jma_teacher_view_v1=1, sessionStorage jma_audio_unlocked_v1=1. All purely localStorage — no backend touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VERIFIED testids: audio-unlock-overlay (image src ends with assets/ui/logo.png, width 78%), player-name-prompt (also has logo.png, NO Music lucide icon), player-name-input/submit/skip, teacher-view-toggle, open-print-report (only visible when teacherView is ON), print-report-modal, print-report-name (pre-fills displayName), print-report-stats (4 cards: Rank/Badges/Streak/Play Time), print-report-domain-{rhythm|ear|keyboard|beat|song|scholar} (each shows ✓ on earned tiers), print-report-backup/print-btn/close, rank-badge (navigates #/sticker-book), next-mission-panel, domain-blurb-rhythm vs domain-teacher-desc-rhythm. CAVEAT: usePlayTime increments jma_total_play_ms_v1 every ~1s while the page is open — when asserting `progress.totalPlayMs` from a downloaded snapshot, allow a small upward drift from the seeded value (or pause the page before grabbing the download). Direct .click(force=True) on the chunky-btn inside the action bar was sometimes flaky (Playwright reported click but React onClick didn't fire); fallback `await page.evaluate(\"() => document.querySelector(...).click()\")` was 100% reliable. Hash routing #/ does NOT remount React — use page.reload() after seeding localStorage.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bugs found. The two intermediate test failures (#4 strict snapshot.totalPlayMs == 125000, #5 strict localStorage value == '125000') were TEST-script artifacts: the live usePlayTime hook had incremented totalPlayMs to 127000 by the time the assertion ran. The snapshot file itself is correct — it captured the LIVE value (127000), which is the intended behavior. Re-running with a relaxed assertion (`>= 125000`) passes. All 6 review acceptance criteria are functionally satisfied: shield logo on both overlay & name prompt (no Music icon present), print report renders snapshot data correctly, backup JSON is canonical (schemaVersion=1, playerId, displayName, progress.achievements x6, practiceStreak, totalPlayMs, deviceSettings.teacherView), playerStorage not exposed on window, all regression flows intact (teacher toggle flips kid/teacher descriptions, rank-badge navigates to sticker-book, next-mission-panel renders, audio overlay dismisses on tap).
